issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Farm feeding operation: the problem statement and UML specify a Farm method named feedAllAnimals() (problem_statement.md lines 108-111) and the solution implements and calls feedAllAnimals() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 27-31 and solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 20). In the template, the example code contains a (commented) call to farm.feed() (template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 20). This inconsistent naming in the provided example can confuse students about which method to implement (they may implement feed() instead of feedAllAnimals() or be uncertain which API the exercise expects).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the UML and solution. Preferred: update the example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (replace farm.feed()). Alternatively, add a small delegating method in the Farm template: public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); } and document this, but updating the example to feedAllAnimals() is recommended to avoid confusion.
